title: Dependency declared only by exclusions
description: package.json declares a specifier that names only versions to exclude. An exclusion-only declaration accepts every other release, including every future one, so the dependency is effectively unbounded.
remediation: Add an upper bound or pin the exact version under test.
limitation: It matches a specifier that names only versions to exclude in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
